Product Details: EASY PLUG & PLAY CHARGING: This torch features an integrated slider switch for effortless recharging. Just slide and plug in—no external wires required. The plug-&-play design eliminates wire damage risks and offers a smooth, hassle-free charging experience. SLA BATTERY POWER: Powered by a reliable SLA (Sealed Lead Acid) battery that offers steady performance. Designed for consistent lighting when you need it most. OVERCHARGE & DEEP DISCHARGE PROTECTION: This torch is equipped with overcharge & deep discharge protection automatically stopping charging once the battery is full to prevent overheating and cuts off power when the battery is too low, protecting it from damage and ensuring longer battery life. CHARGING INDICATOR: This torch features LED indicators that display charging progress and signal when the battery is fully charged. On a full charge, it provides up to 3 hours of bright white light, ensuring reliable performance during power cuts, outdoor tasks, or travel. SLIDE SWITCH: The intuitive slide switch ensures easy operation, even in low light or while wearing gloves, making it simple to use with one hand. BUILT-IN WRIST SLING: Designed with user convenience in mind, this torch comes with a durable built-in wrist sling that ensures easy and secure carrying wherever you go. This wrist sling adds stability and helps prevent drops during outdoor use or extended handling. 6-MONTH WARRANTY: The Eveready DL-50 comes with a 6-month manufacturer’s warranty against any manufacturing defects, ensuring worry-free usage and dependable after-sales support. ERGONOMIC AND DURABLE BUILD: Designed for everyday reliability, this torch features a tough scratch-resistant ABS plastic body paired with a uniquely ergonomic handle. The built-in non-slip grip strip ensures comfortable, fatigue-free handling, perfect for extended use in any environment.
